name: 07_quiet_relative_to_peers
mechanism: Shrink both tails when a series' EWMA absolute daily log change is substantially smaller than the collector-class peers'. Pooling can import excessive volatility from differently priced offers.
prediction: Practice pooled skill rises 0.001 to 0.005; most gain comes from unchanged or under-1% outcomes.
evidence_before_edit: Reference mix pools peer returns without volatility normalization; the own-versus-peer volatility feature is causal and fixed before scoring.
